subject.title: [Bug]: memsearch-summarize sub-session compaction fails with "No API provider registered for api: ollama" on 2026.7.1, while main-session compaction with the same provider succeeds

question: Should the current-main provider-registration fix ship only in the next scheduled stable release, or be backported to a v2026.7.x patch release?
rationale: The bug is bounded but repeatedly degrades memory summaries for stable users, while the exact fix commit and backport safety still require release-owner judgment.

options.title: Ship Next Stable
options.body: Identify the fix commit, retain it on main, and tell affected users the next scheduled stable version containing it.

options.title: Backport to 2026.7.x
options.body: Cherry-pick the minimal fix into the release line after focused native-Ollama compaction and upgrade verification.

recommendation.title: Ship Next Stable
recommendation.body: Identify the fix commit, retain it on main, and tell affected users the next scheduled stable version containing it.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to prior Ollama compaction handling and release-level issue resolution.
